title: brain's MCP server back into AIP-3, last checkpoint
quote: Yes: put it back into AIP-3 as its last checkpoint.
means: AIP-3 builds brain's MCP server as its own last checkpoint, serving the same verbs brain.mjs exports (D-47). AIP-3 gave it to AIP-4 only so it would not wait on AIP-4's Gate A (D-55); with AIP-4 dropped (D-64), nothing is left to wait on.

supersedes.what: The MCP server moves back from AIP-4 into AIP-3, as its last checkpoint.

reflection.checked: every decision before D-72 that held
reflection.result: supersedes D-55 (whole); closes the conflict D-64 left with D-55
